title: What does "instant thermalization" in large-$q$ SYK models mean?
summary: Motivated by the Planckian thermalization rate $Γ\sim T$ observed in the two-body interacting SYK model, we study thermalization in the $q/2$-body case. Previous studies of such systems have established the notion of instantaneous thermalization to leading order in $1/q$. It was conjectured that the thermalization may still be Planckian but with a divergent rate $Γ\sim T q$, explaining the ``instantaneous'' part.
